items.location: Northwest end of Thunderbird Family Sports Complex, 6105 N. Durango Dr, northwest Las Vegas (Centennial Hills area); Ward 4

items.summary: The Nevada State Veterans Memorial, 18 larger-than-life bronze statues by sculptor Douwe Blumberg that honor American military service from the Revolutionary War to the present, has a new permanent home in a park setting at Thunderbird Family Sports Complex. The statues were commissioned by the state in 2011 and moved from outside the former Grant Sawyer state office building. The new site adds an open-air promenade with landscaping, an amphitheater and informational signage. The city scheduled a free public unveiling for Veterans Day 2026.
items.whyItMatters: A new public place in northwest Las Vegas that residents, families and visiting veterans can actually go to, inside a park many Centennial Hills/Skye Canyon-area families already use. Answers 'where did the veterans memorial go?' and 'what is new at Thunderbird park?'. Highly visual, public, and not covered by LVINIT.
